scenes.title: Crash into the Society of the Blind
scenes.summary: After crashing the test-drive BMW into the Sineozersk branch of the Society of the Blind, drunken Samson breathes into a police breathalyser while Golovkin arrives as his lawyer; on TV news fire engines surround the building, and Ilona tells Arkady their campaign is ruined. Opening song.

scenes.title: Campaign disaster
scenes.summary: In the morning kitchen TV news reports Samson's drunken crash into the Society of the Blind and an ATM robbery on Garibaldi Street; Arkady scolds Nina for drinking with Samson, Ilona despairs over how to spin crashing a BMW into disabled people, and Nina warns that once Samson remembers he will die of shame.

scenes.title: The sober driver
scenes.summary: Hungover Samson walks into the kitchen with a bruised face and no memory of the crash; Arkady seizes the chance to tell him he heroically stopped restaurant hooligans who were harassing Nina, returned the car without a scratch and called a sober driver, then introduces Ilona as his campaign chief.

scenes.title: Off to the dacha
scenes.summary: Once Samson leaves to wash up, Nina warns he will learn the truth from TV or the street, so Arkady and Golovkin decide to take him out of town to Golovkin's dacha; in the corridor Klavdia Viktorovna taunts Samson, and Arkady threatens to take back her TVs and cemetery plot if she says a word.

scenes.title: A fantastic version
scenes.summary: In Arkady's room he and Ilona brainstorm absurd cover stories for why Samson rammed the Society of the Blind, before Arkady sends Ilona to talk to the blind society in person and promise them anything to settle the scandal.

scenes.title: The debt collectors
scenes.summary: Two debt collectors from a microloan firm, Uncle Grisha and Kostik, confront Marina in the corridor demanding 150,000 roubles in interest on the 20,000-rouble loan she took for Lyosha's treatment and threatening the boy; Marina pushes them out the door threatening to call the police.

scenes.title: Kostik's scary face
scenes.summary: On the stairs Uncle Grisha berates timid Kostik because no one is afraid of them or pays up; Kostik insists he was making a scary face to illustrate Grisha's threats, and Grisha tells him he should have smashed a wardrobe and says they will return after lunch.

scenes.title: Arkady's advice
scenes.summary: In the kitchen a worried Marina asks Arkady if the debt collectors' threats are serious; Arkady tells her to pay them or ask her boyfriend Dean Eduard Vladimirovich, pointing out that the dean stole a city-donated computer lab and bought the rector a floor-length mink coat.

scenes.title: At the Society of the Blind
scenes.summary: Ilona visits the damaged Society of the Blind to apologise, but chairman Gennady Andreyevich says they begged Anikeev for a new building for fifteen years whereas Osipenko just promised to build one; outside on the phone, Arkady tells Ilona he signed the building order two years ago and realises Osipenko stole the money.
scenes.location: Society of the Blind / communal flat

scenes.title: Run to the village
scenes.summary: Marina goes to Dean Eduard Vladimirovich for help with the 150,000-rouble microloan debt; the dean blames her for not reading the fine print, says his wife Rector Alla Yevgenyevna monitors his bank card by SMS, and advises Marina to flee with Lyosha to her mother's village for six months.

scenes.title: Briefing with the general
scenes.summary: Major Lavrov, Captain Zavarzin and Mikhail Mikhailovich report by video link to Moscow General Kruglov, who first confuses their operation with an Urals poison case and then orders that the young archive lieutenant Lyova Sokolov be included in the next briefing.

scenes.title: At Danila's dacha
scenes.summary: At Golovkin's country house Samson criticises the uneven wall seams, then spots a steering-wheel bruise on his chest and asks if he wrecked the BMW; Golovkin invents a second lie on the spot, claiming the restaurant hooligans were the Garibaldi Street ATM robbers and Samson rammed their getaway car head-on.

scenes.title: In the City Hall archive
scenes.summary: Ilona slips into the City Hall archive, where archivist Lydia Alexeyevna tries to chase her out until Ilona whispers that she is secretly working for Arkady Borisovich; Lydia gives her five minutes.

scenes.title: A coward doesn't play hockey
scenes.summary: While posing on the ice in hockey gear, Governor Viktor Stepanovich warns Pasha that Anikeev might find his old order allocating funds to the blind society and orders Pasha to shred it at City Hall; meanwhile Arkady phones Ilona in the archive to guide her search.

scenes.title: A demonstration for the collectors
scenes.summary: Uncle Grisha and Kostik return to the flat while Lyosha is alone and start smashing furniture in Marina's room; Arkady steps in and invites them to his room to talk, and when they recognise him as the disgraced mayor, Uncle Grisha twists his sore ear and dares him to call his guards.
scenes.location: communal flat, Marina's and Arkady's rooms

scenes.title: The mayor's gold watch
scenes.summary: Arkady phones his former guard Vitalik for help, but the guards decide not to come; when Uncle Grisha and Kostik threaten him with a bottle, terrified Arkady promises to pay Marina's debt and hands over his ten-thousand-dollar Swiss gold watch.

scenes.title: Lydia Alexeyevna's honour
scenes.summary: In the City Hall archive Ilona copies Arkady's order just as Pasha comes upstairs; to delay him, archivist Lydia Alexeyevna intercepts Pasha in the corridor with a dramatic declaration of love and makes him promise to protect her womanly honour while Ilona slips away.

scenes.title: My chosen one
scenes.summary: At the dacha table Nina praises Samson as her 'chosen one' while Yulia smirks at her phone; Samson confiscates Yulia's phone and sends her to wash the dishes. (Cutaway: Pasha tells the governor he is shredding the archive folder.)

scenes.title: Personal gain
scenes.summary: Finding her room wrecked, Marina packs to leave with Lyosha; Arkady shows his bare wrist and tells her he paid off her debt with his gold watch, but Marina refuses to believe he would do anything without personal gain and Klavdia accuses him of colluding with the gangsters.

scenes.title: The uncle from Armavir
scenes.summary: At the microloan office Uncle Grisha shows off Arkady's Swiss watch to nervous Kostik; Major Lavrov and Captain Zavarzin arrive posing as Marina's uncle from Armavir and her cousin Vsevolod, effortlessly subdue both collectors, and take the loan contract and Arkady's gold watch.

scenes.title: The construction order
scenes.summary: Ilona shows Gennady Andreyevich and low-vision Andryusha the archive documents proving Anikeev allocated their building funds and Osipenko diverted them to his cousin's firm, but Gennady Andreyevich still refuses to back Samson because Samson will never win.

scenes.title: The truth from Yulia
scenes.summary: At the dacha Nina and Samson go upstairs for a romantic moment, quickly turn off the radio news, and run back down when food burns in the oven; fed up with washing dishes, Yulia blurts out to Samson that he is a drunk who crashed into the Society of the Blind and has been on TV all day.

scenes.title: Five kilos of sage
scenes.summary: Pressured by his staff, Gennady Andreyevich asks Ilona how they can help Samson; spotting spilled dried sage on the floor from the crash, Ilona secretly dumps her own marijuana stash onto the burned sacks so that police sniffer dogs discover 'five kilos of cannabis' and arrest the chairman.

scenes.title: The commendation watch
scenes.summary: At the university Lavrov and Zavarzin assure Marina she is under their protection and the collectors will never bother her again; when Zavarzin helps her with her bag, Marina spots Arkady's gold watch on his wrist, and Lavrov claims it is Zavarzin's commendation watch fresh from repair.

scenes.title: Five kilos of marijuana
scenes.summary: Ashamed of the crash, Samson wants to confess and go to prison until a TV news report announces that his crash uncovered and destroyed five kilograms of marijuana at the Society of the Blind, with Andryusha thanking Samson on air; Samson immediately cheers up.

scenes.title: This is our turf
scenes.summary: In their car bruised Uncle Grisha and Kostik pull out a telescopic baton and plan to throw a Molotov cocktail through Marina's window to get the money and watch back, shouting that they run this turf—until Arkady's giant former guards tap on the window.

scenes.title: The candidate's conscience
scenes.summary: Back at the flat Samson tells Arkady and Ilona he is withdrawing from the race because he could have killed someone driving drunk; Ilona uses reverse psychology, agreeing that Samson has a conscience whereas Osipenko stole the blind people's money and will never build their centre, while Klavdia mocks Arkady's pyjamas.

scenes.title: Time to get smart
scenes.summary: Ilona assures Arkady that her psychology convinced Samson not to quit; in the courtyard Samson apologises to Golovkin, Golovkin tells Nina she can always count on him, and Samson tells Nina he has decided to drink less, read books and grow up.

scenes.title: Any monkey could win
scenes.summary: Sitting in a banya, Governor Viktor Stepanovich phones Pasha to berate him for losing the blind society scandal, asks if Pasha is worse than a monkey, and makes him hold the phone to his ear while being whipped with birch branches.

scenes.title: Marina's gratitude
scenes.summary: Late at night Marina comes to Arkady's room in tears to thank him for saving her from the collectors and asks how she can repay him; when Arkady misreads her gratitude and tries to kiss her, she slaps him and storms out, while the bruised collectors are forced to attend university classes. Closing song.
